source_snapshot.procedure: Check the BIOS version in BMC WebUI.
source_snapshot.criteria: Version should be shown correctly before and after flashing.
source_snapshot.script: Private IPMI-raw firmware-version check reference; contents unavailable and not assumed. Five minutes attended and five machine minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; provides read-only Redfish/OS version collection, implies AFUEFI completion without a safe flash contract, and uses TLS/SSH bypass.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; separates version reads from any authorized flash and requires exact image/hardware identity, hash, compatibility, activation, rollback, secure access and post-boot evidence.

old_problem: The Procedure only names a BMC WebUI version read while Criteria requires correct values before and after flashing. The previous record correctly refused to infer whether this row owns the flash and left that scope decision Pending. The same display code also identifies Functionality row 337 / variant 41a6c1e8dcb952c7, whose explicit AFUEFI upgrade command and `/P /B /N /ME` region flags are a separate testcase and cannot be imported merely because the codes match.
disposition_reason: User-approved ED-07 chooses the flash-owning interpretation for this exact Source Key/variant. The Review layer therefore retains a complete BIOS image write, required activation and independent before/after BMC WebUI version verification. It parameterizes—without guessing—the vendor-approved update mechanism, signed image, complete-image/region policy, target version, active-versus-staged mapping, maintenance/reset behavior and recovery runbook. Missing bindings make an execution NOT READY; they do not reopen flash ownership. A fresh human-visible WebUI capture is primary evidence, with secure Redfish FirmwareInventory, update Task and SMBIOS used as separately mapped corroboration. Row 337 remains independently executable and receives no cross-credit.
decision_basis: Master XLSX physical rows 1433-1437, exact row-1436 DeepSeek columns, tests.json, exact GPT second review, locked manifest, historical V3.1 record and duplicate-code row 337 / variant 41a6c1e8dcb952c7 were read directly. Formal queue sequence 92 was separately derived as row 1448 / variant c3653cb3ee2b1789.

ED-07 is case-specific authority that this row owns a complete BIOS flash with before/after version verification. It resolves the prior read-only-versus-flash source conflict but is not itself execution authorization.

The source does not name an update command. ED-34 permits the project to bind an approved AFUEFI, AFULnx, BMC UpdateService or other vendor method while recording original/actual tools and equivalence. Importing row 337's AFUEFI command or flags without target documentation would violate duplicate identity and OEM-command safety.

Complete flash means the exact regions and preservation policy defined by the approved target package are written and verified; it does not mean blindly enabling every vendor flag. Image signature/hash, board/product/revision compatibility, current/target version, secure-boot/TPM/NVRAM impact and release notes are preflight gates.

The pre-state is captured before any write. The update mechanism's accepted request is not completion: record transfer/write/verification progress and terminal status, then execute only the approved activation/reboot/reset path and wait for the same target to return through POST to OS Ready.

DMTF Redfish UpdateService defines firmware/software update mechanisms and Task monitoring, while FirmwareInventory supplies component inventory. Those standard interfaces do not identify the correct OEM image, guarantee that the BIOS is active rather than staged/cached, or replace the source-required rendered WebUI view.

The post-state needs a fresh authenticated WebUI session/page reload tied to the same BMC/host, exact target version and timestamp. A human confirms the rendered BIOS-version label/value; validated Redfish inventory and SMBIOS Type 0 must agree only under an owner-approved property mapping.

Because the rendered BMC WebUI before/after state is core acceptance and the destructive flash requires supervised authorization, formal capability is MANUAL ONLY. Automation may prepare artifacts, monitor update tasks and collect machine evidence, but cannot own the visual observation or engineer verdict.

Rollback is not an automatic downgrade. Before the write, prove the platform-supported recovery path—dual-bank/recovery image/service procedure or independently approved rollback image—and stop for owner direction on failure. No automatic reflash, alternate flags, reset or power cycle is allowed.

ED-02 preserves the duplicate variants; ED-07 sets this row's complete-flash scope; ED-13/ED-14 retain point-of-action approval and safety; ED-20/ED-23 require actual non-stale GUI evidence; ED-26/ED-38 prohibit retry and agent verdicts; ED-34/ED-35 preserve tool choice and full mutation coverage; ED-36 makes project artifacts readiness; ED-46 requires image selection, update, activation, homepage readback and normal boot as distinct checkpoints.

test_case.test_name: Complete BIOS flash with BMC WebUI before/after active-version verification
test_case.purpose: Perform one project-approved complete BIOS image transition on the exact target and prove, through fresh human-visible BMC WebUI evidence plus mapped update/inventory/SMBIOS telemetry, that the correct version changes from the approved baseline to the active target and the platform recovers normally.
required_package: Exact Source Key/variant and BMC/host/board/product/revision/serial identities; current BIOS, BMC, ME/CPLD and critical setup/configuration baseline

Signed or owner-designated full BIOS image, cryptographic hash, release notes, authoritative current/target version strings, hardware compatibility and complete-image/region plus configuration-preservation policy

Vendor- and platform-approved BIOS update tool/path with exact version/hash and parameterized `APPROVED_BIOS_UPDATE_COMMAND`; explicit statement of regions written, verification method, activation/reboot/reset sequence and expected duration/status
Fresh BMC WebUI path/label, trusted certificate and secure credentials; validated Redfish FirmwareInventory/UpdateService/Task and SMBIOS property mappings for corroboration
Maintenance window, stable redundant power where required, validated KVM/OOB and OS console, explicit point-of-action flash/activation approval, abort criteria and protected evidence store

Pre-staged platform recovery runbook and artifacts: supported recovery/dual-bank/service mechanism or separately validated rollback image, configuration backup, owner contacts and post-recovery health checklist
test_case.test_command: DESTRUCTIVE HYBRID MANUAL WORKFLOW; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind Source Key/variant and prove BMC-to-host identity. Preserve logs and capture/hash complete pre-state: fresh authenticated BMC WebUI BIOS-version page, mapped Redfish FirmwareInventory, SMBIOS Type 0, current/staged/active versions, firmware/configuration health and recovery readiness. Verify the signed full image, board/revision compatibility, exact update tool and complete-image/region policy; display the literal project-supplied `APPROVED_BIOS_UPDATE_COMMAND`, expected statuses, activation action and recovery contract. Obtain separate immediate authorization for the write and any reset/reboot. Execute that exact command/path once under stable power and qualified supervision; never substitute row 337 flags. Monitor native update/task/write/verify evidence to a terminal success before the approved activation. Do not interrupt or power-cycle an in-progress flash. Activate exactly as documented, correlate BMC/POST/KVM and wait for the same host to reach OS Ready. Start a fresh WebUI session or force an authoritative reload, capture the rendered BIOS-version label/value, then collect mapped Redfish active/staged inventory and SMBIOS. Compare pre versus target/post values, verify image/region status and platform/configuration/TPM/Secure-Boot/ME/BMC/log health. Preserve all records and issue only Tool Result for engineer verdict.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved complete image is accepted, written and verified once without update error or interruption; required activation finishes and the same platform returns through POST to OS Ready. The fresh BMC WebUI shows the exact approved target BIOS version after having shown the exact approved baseline before the flash. Mapped Redfish active FirmwareInventory and SMBIOS agree, no stale/staged-only value is mistaken for active firmware, required configuration/security state is preserved or restored per policy, and no unrelated critical firmware/health/log error appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant/target, approved complete image and region policy, image signature/hash and compatibility, literal approved command/path, explicit write plus activation approvals, single uninterrupted terminal-success update, same-target POST-to-OS-Ready recovery, genuine fresh WebUI before/after visual captures with exact baseline/target values, mapped active/staged Redfish and SMBIOS agreement, and healthy required configuration/security/firmware state. FAIL covers valid-contract write/verify/activation error, wrong active version, WebUI/API/SMBIOS disagreement, stale/staged-only display, boot/health/configuration regression or recovery failure. NOT READY covers any missing target/image/hash/tool/region policy/version mapping/approval/stable power/KVM/recovery input; do not flash. N/A requires authoritative proof the function is unsupported and does not convert missing prerequisites or a defect. Request acceptance or row 337 evidence alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Firmware flash is destructive and service-impacting. Review completion is not permission: obtain explicit point-of-action authorization after presenting exact target, image hash, tool/command, regions, expected duration, activation and recovery.

Use only an exact board/revision-compatible approved full image and vendor-supported tool/parameters. Do not infer `latest`, borrow row 337's AFUEFI flags, force an unsupported downgrade, change the image or narrow complete-flash coverage silently.
Prove stable power, maintenance isolation, BMC/KVM reachability and recovery readiness before writing. Never interrupt, reset or power-cycle during an active transfer/write/verify phase.
Preserve pre-flash WebUI/API/SMBIOS values, configuration and all diagnostic logs; do not clear SEL/OS/update history or expose credentials. Require trusted TLS and reject host/target ambiguity.

Execute the approved update path at most once. On any error, unexpected status/version or lost telemetry, stop and preserve first-failure state; no automatic retry, alternate tool/flags/image, blind activation, rollback or recovery flash.

A human must confirm actual rendered BMC WebUI evidence before and after. API, task success, screenshot analysis or cached browser content cannot substitute; correlate a fresh session with target identity and timestamp.

Recovery or rollback is separately owner-directed. A downgrade image may run only if independently supported and approved; otherwise use the vendor recovery/dual-bank/service path without improvisation.
The review agent performs no flash, reset, reboot, power cycle, recovery or DUT test and never declares hardware PASS.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/host/board/revision/serial; current BIOS/BMC/ME/CPLD and configuration/security baseline; duplicate row-337 identity kept separate
Full image name/version/hash/signature/provenance/release note, compatibility decision, complete-image/region policy, actual tool version/hash and literal approved command/path
Fresh pre-flash WebUI capture plus mapped Redfish FirmwareInventory and SMBIOS output; active/staged distinction; preserved logs and configuration backup
Point-of-action approvals, stable-power/KVM/recovery readiness, full transfer/write/verify/task telemetry and terminal status with synchronized timestamps
Approved activation/reboot timeline, same-target BMC/KVM/POST/OS Ready evidence and no interruption or retry
Fresh post-activation WebUI capture with exact target version, mapped Redfish active inventory and SMBIOS, required region/configuration/TPM/Secure-Boot/ME/BMC health and complete logs
Recovery readiness/outcome, Tool Result, engineer verdict placeholder and explicit no-DUT-action-by-review-agent statement
test_case.recovery: Before writing, stage and validate the exact vendor recovery or dual-bank/service procedure, recovery artifact/hash, configuration backup and OOB path. If the update fails before terminal success, preserve task/tool/BMC/KVM/log evidence, do not activate, retry or power-cycle, and obtain firmware-owner direction. If activation or boot fails, preserve first-failure state and use only the pre-approved target-specific recovery runbook; any rollback/downgrade requires its own support and approval. After owner-directed recovery, verify the recovered active version in fresh WebUI, Redfish and SMBIOS, restore approved configuration, and prove POST, OS Ready, TPM/Secure-Boot/ME/BMC/log health. Quarantine the target if recovery authority or telemetry is absent.

source_conflict.reason: ED-07 explicitly selects the flash-owning interpretation for this exact row. The review now has one coherent scope: complete BIOS flash plus the source's before/after BMC WebUI version acceptance, without importing the duplicate row's command.

blocked.reason: Flash semantics, evidence and safety boundaries are complete. Exact OEM tool/image/regions/activation/recovery are mandatory Project bindings and keep the run NOT READY when absent; they are not guessed and do not require another scope decision.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact target and baseline/target versions; signed full image/hash/release note; compatible update tool/literal command and complete-region policy; BMC WebUI/Redfish/SMBIOS mapping; stable power/KVM; write/activation authorization; activation timing; vendor recovery/rollback runbook and health thresholds.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Specification DSP0266 v1.15.1
external_authorities.application: Defines UpdateService update mechanisms and asynchronous task monitoring; it supports telemetry contracts but does not select an OEM BIOS image, target or recovery path.

external_authorities.title: DMTF Redfish Data Model Specification DSP0268 2025.2
external_authorities.application: Defines UpdateService and FirmwareInventory resources used to correlate update and active/staged inventory; target-specific resource mapping and actual rendered WebUI remain project evidence.

project_authority: The BIOS/platform owner binds the exact full image, target version, tool/command, complete-region/preservation policy, activation and independently supported recovery; operations authorizes the maintenance, write and reset at point of action; a human owns WebUI observations and final verdict. None may guess OEM flags, substitute a partial/read-only check, reuse row 337 as execution evidence, accept staged/cached inventory as active, waive recovery or authorize automatic retry.
